subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot adopt the same fixed 30-second opening-handshake ceiling used by sibling channel transports, accepting that gateways or proxies taking longer will reconnect instead of eventually connecting?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but changing an unbounded connection wait into fail-closed behavior is an upgrade-sensitive availability choice that green CI cannot approve.

options.title: Approve the 30-second bound
options.body: Land the plugin-local fixed timeout after rebasing and verifying it coexists with the adjacent payload-limit option.

options.title: Require an adjustable budget
options.body: Ask for a QQBot-owned or inherited timeout only if maintainers have evidence that legitimate supported handshakes can exceed 30 seconds.

options.title: Keep the wait unbounded
options.body: Decline the availability hardening and retain the current permanent-stall failure mode for never-completing upgrades.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Land the plugin-local fixed timeout after rebasing and verifying it coexists with the adjacent payload-limit option.
